evidence.note: Runs i32 family json, reads i32 failures, then runs all MVP suite — per-family isolation right after building.
Drills into specific FAIL lines (memory line 10/11, block line 363) to localize and fix individual failing assertions, then re-tests.
Re-runs full MVP suite and checks for panics after fixes — periodic aggregate regression check while iterating.
Runs simd_const then SIMD tests as a batch, computes overall score, and produces a breakdown of remaining failures — monitors aggregate signal but SIMD verification is coarser than MVP.

Categorizes invalid/malformed errors, inspects malformed bytes, builds a validator, then recomputes score and finds remaining failures — distinguishes genuine bugs from encoding/validation mismatches.
Re-tests after validator integration and recomputes score, guarding against MVP regressions; ends verifying a few tests without clear evidence of reaching exact 1.0.

reasoning: For MVP the agent runs a genuine systematic loop — per-family json runs, reading specific FAIL @ line reasons, targeted fixes, re-runs to green, and periodic full-runner checks with regression guarding after the validator was added — which matches the level-8 anchor. However SIMD (the largest surface) is verified more coarsely as an aggregate batch rather than per-family with edge-case (NaN/saturation/lane-order) drilling, and the run stops short of demonstrably chasing an exact 1.0, keeping it below the level-10 'engineered verification' bar. This places it between the 5 and 8 anchors, leaning high: a 7.
